issue.title: test_agent_xprompt_highlights_warm_catalog_skills fails under full parallel lane, live post-fix
issue.description: tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_agent_display_xprompt.py::TestAgentXPromptRendering::test_agent_xprompt_highlights_warm_catalog_skills failed under the full parallel test lane at 2026-08-10T17:22:46Z, head dcb243b75. dcb243b75 already contains all three sase-iy epic mechanism fixes (catalog 128b326ea, waitgate c49452c47, residue ebd3a91bc), so this is a genuinely post-fix failure, not explained by any of them. It passes in isolation (confirmed alongside 6 other formerly-flagged nodes: 7 passed in 29.46s on master c8e4016c7), but per the sase-ct retirement, an isolation pass is not evidence of a fix -- fails-under-full-parallel/passes-alone is exactly the retired umbrella's signature. Independently observed and routed to epic sase-iy by recurrence agent xd at 2026-08-10T17:26Z. Root cause not yet identified; needs its own investigation into what shared state or timing this test depends on under full parallel load.
